ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.2): Enugu Launches ESHDC Independence Land Promo & Advances 10.5km Igogoro-Amaja Road Project
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.1): Bayelsa Holds Bilateral Economic Talks with Lesotho on Starch Export and Textile Warehousing
SOKOTO STATE (PSI 7.0): Sokoto Rebuts False Abduction Reports Regarding Gamji College Students
KADUNA STATE (PSI 6.9): Kaduna Receives NIPR Praise for Restoring Information Ministry & Proactive Communication
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 6.8): Anambra Swears In Elected Mayors and Deputy Mayors Across 21 LGAs

KATSINA (PSI 9.4): Flagged off NFWP-SU 40k women empowerment with VP Shettima, commissioned CPS underpass/Polo ring roads, launched 32 hybrid buses/200 electric tricycles, and won 2026 GovTech Award for digitalizing 118 MDAs.
JIGAWA (PSI 9.3): Governor Namadi assented to the N63.48bn Supplementary Budget, allocating N46.37bn for state government infrastructure and N17.11bn across 27 local government councils.
ZAMFARA (PSI 9.2): Approved N70.9bn contract award to CCECC for the 53km Gusau–Jauri–Nasarawar Godel road and flagged off a 95km road network across Tsafe LGA to improve trade and regional security.
GOMBE (PSI 9.1): Commissioned over 86km of rural-urban roads under Network-1100 with Borno Governor Zulum and inaugurated 13 LCDA secretariats including Kwami West.

ABIA (PSI 9.0): Approved N1bn Teachers Appreciation Allowance, confirmed recruitment of 9,469 teachers, extended teacher retirement age to 65, made executive appointments, and showcased comprehensive Ohafia LGA projects.

ONDO (PSI 8.9): Honoured as FG Best Governor in Education at 2026 World Teachers Day, citing N3.1bn classroom projects and WAEC sponsorships, and approved new Senior Special Assistants and Government House Chief Imam.

NIGER (PSI 8.8): Secured N250m FG relief and disbursed N249m state aid (N5m per deceased family, N2m per survivor) for NSCDC mining tragedy victims during VP Shettima's visit, and swore in 6 new commissioners.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.7): Governor Otu inspected the devastating Anansa Street landslide requesting FG technical aid, assessed the Odukpani tanker fire, issued a 48-hour retraction ultimatum to PDP, and advanced climate/cancer initiatives.

TARABA (PSI 8.6): Presided over 16 LGA MoU signing with Origin Tech for rural roads utilizing N16bn equipment, unveiled Responsible Mining Standards, and presented N2.5bn in social intervention cheques.

OSUN (PSI 8.5): Signed the Osun Park Management Bill into law, filed Federal High Court motion to vacate an ex-parte asset freeze order obtained by Gamji Nigeria Ltd, and reaffirmed Mrs. Oyebode Mary as Iyaloja General.
KWARA (PSI 8.4): Presented N120m in cash prizes to top teachers/schools on World Teachers Day and announced state-funded Dangote Refinery IPO share purchases for active and retired female teachers.

EBONYI (PSI 8.3): Celebrated ranking 2nd nationally in 2026 NECO SSCE (81.03% pass rate) with Urban Model Secondary placing 2nd overall, and inspected the Igwe-Okpu Ohainya Nkaleke-Unuphu-PRESCO road corridor.

LAGOS (PSI 8.2): Hosted Power Minister Tegbe at the Clean Lagos Electricity Market retreat targeting 6,000MW capacity, while Treasury Office tasked state finance heads on compliance, performance, and AI adoption.
NASARAWA (PSI 8.1): Commissioned Karshi Judicial Complex donated by Sarkin Karshi, flagged off distribution of 50,000 free Dangote shares for women across 6 LGAs, and attended 2026 NIPR Conference.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.0): Announced the recruitment of 3,000 basic education teachers during World Teachers Day, created the Teaching Service Commission, and held the Ministry of Energy's inaugural management meeting.

PLATEAU (PSI 7.9): Reached 98% completion on 70-transformer electricity intervention, won Finest Pavilion at 21st ACCI Trade Fair with 27k cooperative plan, and directed security probe into Bukuru Kara market trader attack.

DELTA (PSI 7.8): Inspected collapsed East-West Road at Agbarho following 6-day heavy rains, funded Julius Berger palliative works to reopen traffic, and commissioned permanent mini-bridge hydraulic studies.

EDO (PSI 7.7): Conducted Independence outreach to Oko Custodial Centre pledging justice review for awaiting-trial inmates, held strike resolution talks with MDCAN, and EDOSEMA distributed flood palliatives in Etsako Central.
EKITI (PSI 7.6): Disbursed N70.5m in cash rewards to outstanding teachers and school administrators on World Teachers Day, noting over N18bn cumulative executive investment in education.
KEBBI (PSI 7.5): Visited Kaoje in Bagudo LGA following security attacks, providing N100m additional support (bringing total state aid to N200m) and deploying additional operational security assets.

RIVERS (PSI 7.4): Presented Certificate of Recognition and Staff of Office to King Charles Douglas Mac-Pepple Jaja, Jeki VI as Amanyanabo of Opobo Kingdom, resolving a 27-year chieftaincy legal dispute.
OGUN (PSI 7.3): Opened discussions with NNPC to revive the Olokola LNG (OKLNG) project on 1,728 hectares, integrating it with the $7bn Gateway Deep Sea Port and Blue Marine Free Zone.

ENUGU (PSI 7.2): ESHDC launched Independence property promo offering a free plot grand prize at Smart City Satellite Town, while advancing construction on the 10.5km Igogoro-Ikpamodo-Amaja road corridor.
BAYELSA (PSI 7.1): Governor Diri held bilateral economic talks in Maseru with Lesotho Prime Minister Matekane to advance trade in cassava starch export, oil/gas services, and fisheries.
SOKOTO (PSI 7.0): Issued an official press statement debunking false reports of 18 Gamji College students abducted, clarifying that a single alumna was abducted while traveling through Niger State.
KADUNA (PSI 6.9): Received NIPR commendation for re-establishing the Ministry of Information and Culture under Commissioner Ahmed Maiyaki, enhancing proactive state communication and peacebuilding.
ANAMBRA (PSI 6.8): Swore in newly elected Mayors and Deputy Mayors across all 21 Local Government Areas, charging them with grassroots development, humility, and strict fiscal accountability.
